author: DTrim99
body:
Confirmed — both differences are on our side, in policyengine-us. The page 7 worksheet settles the federal tax deduction question.

**1. $450 of the gap: our federal income tax deduction base nets out the 2021 child tax credit.** The 2021 Line 9 worksheet defines tax from federal return as 1040 Line 22 less Lines 27a and 29, Schedule 2 Part I Line 3, and Schedule 3 Lines 9 and 13c. Because the 2021 CTC was fully refundable (Line 28), it never reduces Line 22 — as on the TaxAct return (Line 9 = 5,923 → × 15% = 888). PolicyEngine starts from tax after all refundable credits and adds back only the recovery rebate and EIC, so its base is 5,921.50 − 3,000 = 2,921.50 → a 438.23 deduction. We'll add the refundable CTC (and the 2021 refundable dependent-care credit) to the add-back list — the Line 9 worksheet never subtracts Line 28 in later years either. Tracked in PolicyEngine/policyengine-us#9094.

**2. $1,400 of the gap: we apply Missouri's head-of-household additional exemption in 2021, but it isn't on the 2021 form.** RSMo 143.161.2 provides a $1,400 additional exemption for HoH/QW filers, and it is Line 15 of the current MO-1040 — but that line first appeared on the 2022 form. On the 2021 MO-1040, Line 15 is the long-term care insurance deduction, and the 2021 booklet never mentions the $1,400. (HB 2540 (2018) conditioned the 143.161.1 dependency exemption on the federal §151 amount being nonzero but left 143.161.2 unconditioned; DOR nonetheless kept it off the 2018–2021 forms and restored it as Line 15 in 2022.) PolicyEngine added this exemption recently with a 2021 start date — one year too early. Tracked in PolicyEngine/policyengine-us#9093.

Reconciliation: PE taxable income 49,874.28 + 1,400 − 450 = 50,824.28 vs 50,833 on the MO-1040; the residual $8.72 traces to the TaxAct federal return showing $8 of taxable interest (Line 2b) although intrec = 0, plus rounding of pwages 70,512.508 → 70,513. Tax after fixes ≈ 2,557 vs 2,558.

Example household:
```
taxsimid,year,state,mstat,page,sage,depx,pwages,rentpaid,idtl
10784726,2021,26,1,37,0,1,70512.508,9793.8545,5
```

One question while we're in this worksheet: it says the EIC must be subtracted from the Line 9 tax ("Line 22 less Line 27a"). Does taxsimtest subtract the EIC from the federal tax deduction base for MO? PolicyEngine currently ignores the EIC there — no effect on this record, but we'd like to align both engines with the form.
